introduction: Illinois Medicaid offers health coverage through several eligibility pathways. Apply through ABE or a local Family Community Resource Center.
description: Illinois Medicaid offers health coverage through several eligibility pathways. Apply through ABE or a local Family Community Resource Center.

sections.who: Eligibility differs for children, pregnant applicants, adults, older people and people with disabilities. Use HFS’s program guidance for each applicant; income and other conditions are not identical across groups.
sections.get: The approved program and plan determine covered services and participating providers. Enrollment notices explain the coverage and next steps.

sections.apply:
1. Apply

    Use ABE, phone 800-843-6154, a local center or a paper application.

  2. Save the tracking number

    Online submission produces a T-number. Keep it to track the request.

  3. Return verification

    Follow any notice requesting additional information.
sections.after: Keep contact details current through Manage My Case. HFS’s federal-change guidance says some ACA adult work and six-month review requirements begin in 2027; read the dated notice for your group.
sections.sources: Reviewed October 1, 2026 using HFS application instructions, program pathways, dated federal Medicaid changes. The administering organization decides eligibility.

faqs: Can I apply without a fixed home address?
HFS accepts an address where you can receive mail, with the address holder’s agreement.
Can I save an online application?
Yes. HFS describes Save and Exit to resume later.
Does every Medicaid member face the same new rules?
No. HFS identifies the affected groups and exemptions in its current federal-change guidance.
